problem_type: Vitest test environment state crosses files in a reused forks worker
symptom: modelListingParity's two expected-failure assertions changed result when another test file left NOMI_SETTINGS_DIR set in the same child process.
direct_cause: Tests assigned or deleted process.env directly; Vitest reset modules between files but the process environment survived, so later settings reads used the previous file's root.
class_root: All test environment mutations must use Vitest's stubEnv API and the shared Vitest lane must restore stubs after every test before a reused worker runs another file.
affected_population: All Vitest test files that set NOMI_* or other process environment values.
Forks workers that execute more than one test file, including the CI default lane.
Future tests that add a direct process.env assignment or delete.
entry_points: Every vi.stubEnv call in the converted Vitest test files.
The modelListingParity beforeAll catalog and preference persistence fixture.
The Vitest config that owns the worker lifecycle.
internal_only_reason: The invariant is entirely in this repository's Vitest fixture harness; no external service decides process environment lifetime.
invariants: A test may override process.env only through vi.stubEnv.
Vitest restores stubbed environment values before the next test in a reused worker.
modelListingParity resolves its catalog and preference paths under the mocked Electron userData root when no inherited override exists.

door_reduction.why_not: The environment writes, shared settings-root read, and two persisted fixture reads are distinct doors. The repair makes every test write converge through Vitest's restore boundary; it does not delete a legitimate catalog or settings read.

generality_proof: The direct-assignment scan found 72 affected Vitest files spanning NOMI_SETTINGS_DIR, NOMI_PROJECTS_DIR, capability, telemetry, proxy, and timeout variables. Converting every write/delete to vi.stubEnv and enabling unstubEnvs at the shared config covers each caller regardless of variable name, file order, or forks worker reuse.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Restore every vi.stubEnv mutation after each test across all Vitest lanes.
Reject direct process.env assignments and deletes in test files and require vi.stubEnv.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The two former direct NOMI_SETTINGS_DIR assignments now use vi.stubEnv and are restored by the shared config.
The beforeEach NOMI_SETTINGS_DIR mutation now uses vi.stubEnv; the old file had no explicit cleanup.
These scripts are outside the Vitest lane and remain governed by their browser/process runner; the ESLint test-file rule intentionally does not claim them.

recurrence.reason: process.env is process-global while forks workers can run multiple files in one child. Any new direct assignment or delete can contaminate a later file, so the mechanism is reusable and not a one-off parity fixture mistake.
same_class_scan: rg -n --glob '*.{test,spec}.{ts,tsx}' 'process\.env.*=|delete process\.env' electron tests found 72 files before the conversion.
The scan covered NOMI_SETTINGS_DIR, NOMI_PROJECTS_DIR, NOMI_CAPABILITY_DIR, NOMI_* timeout/feature variables, proxy variables, and computed environment keys.
The converted direct-write scan is empty; electron/testEnvironmentIsolation.test.ts proves restoration between two tests.

prevention.invariant: Test files cannot assign to or delete process.env directly; all changes enter through vi.stubEnv and Vitest restores them via unstubEnvs.
prevention.failure_mode: ESLint fails with a vi.stubEnv message at the direct assignment/delete, and the regression test fails if restoration is disabled.
prevention.strategy: Put lifecycle restoration in the shared Vitest config and the write prohibition in the shared ESLint test-file rule, so individual fixtures cannot forget cleanup.

legacy_paths.rationale: The parity-only pin was deleted as obsolete test-fixture code, but no production or compatibility path needs migration.

dependency_lifecycle.target: Keep the repository-pinned Vitest major while unstubEnvs remains supported.
dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The required lifecycle primitive is already provided by the installed Vitest runtime; upgrading would not add the missing invariant.
exit_criteria: If a future Vitest major removes unstubEnvs or changes fork lifecycle semantics, replace it with the supported equivalent and rerun electron/testEnvironmentIsolation.test.ts plus the 50-run lane evidence.

migration: No product data changes. Existing tests migrate from direct process.env writes to vi.stubEnv in the same commit; Vitest restores the caller's original values automatically.
residual_risks: tests/ux/** and scripts are outside ESLint's test-file rule and remain an explicitly listed non-Vitest surface.
The two B1 parity assertions remain intentional expected failures; this repair stabilizes their fixture environment and does not change product listing behavior.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The class root is process environment lifetime across test files, so ownership belongs at the shared runner and static write boundary rather than one parity fixture.
